body.condition: The decoder and encoder satisfy \(\lVert f\rVert_{C^k}+\lVert f^{-1}\rVert_{C^k}\le K\).

novel.justification: A uniform \(C^k\) envelope prevents decoder perturbations from concentrating below the scale resolved by the law discrepancy. Periodic shears \(f_\delta(x)=(x_1+\delta\sin x_2,x_2,\ldots,x_n)\) with \(|\delta|<1/2\) form a nontrivial bounded family.
